fix_subject: Fix empty-match handling in regexp_extract_all, anchoring in string_split_regex, and ILIKE upper-case escape
pr_title: Merge #26642: Fix empty-match handling in regexp_extract_all, anchoring in string_split_regex, and ILIKE upper-case escape

labels.summary: Fixes several string-function bugs: regexp_extract_all reported empty matches twice, string_split_regex matched against the remainder instead of the full input so anchors were wrong, regexp_extract returned '' instead of erroring on an invalid non-constant pattern, and ILIKE ESCAPE failed to lowercase the escape character along with the pattern.
